full.text: In a service business, work gets scattered across chats, notes, and spreadsheets.
Sign in with a demo account full of sample data.
The overview shows profit, revenue against costs, where every job stands, and what needs your attention, straight from your own data.
A customer request comes in. The quote agent drafts the scope, price, and terms. Business rules check it before it is saved, and the final call stays with you.
Approved quotes are scheduled to a worker, then marked as done.
Every job is booked, with a running balance kept for you.
The report agent explains this period's numbers, streaming live.
The revenue engines, add-on services and zero waste, find new income and close cost leaks.
Five agent teams and one lead build an optimization plan.
Opportunity radar finds openings in your own data, with the score behind each one.
The prospect finder maps potential customers near you from legal data sources, and AI rates the fit.
